description.value: Bow & Stern is a family-owned, ocean-inspired restaurant founded by the Smith family in 2014, with its Chilliwack location opening in October 2020. The menu centres on a signature fish and chips recipe developed since 1988, alongside full food, drinks, brunch, and dessert menus. This is one of three Fraser Valley–area locations, offering online ordering and group bookings.
